name: shake
description: Shrink a long session by replacing old tool results with saved-file placeholders during compaction

thresholdTokens.title: Shake threshold (tokens)
thresholdTokens.description: Used context, in tokens, at which a shake starts after an answer.

floorShare.title: Floor share
floorShare.description: Least share of the used context that a threshold shake must free. A shake rewrites the prompt cache of what stays, so a small shake costs more than it saves.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: Idle minutes after the last answer until the prompt cache expires. Then a shake runs with no floor, because the next request writes the cache again anyway. 0 turns the idle shake off.
